name: videoseg
title: Alibaba Cloud Video Segmentation
description: Run image and video analysis or generation with Alibaba Cloud Video Segmentation, including video Portrait Segmentation.
useCase: Use for video Portrait Segmentation, and related image or video generation, enhancement, detection, segmentation, and visual analysis.

documentation.markdown:
## Spend-aware usage

- Choose the most specific image or video endpoint for the requested transformation, recognition, detection, or generation task before paying.
- Do not run multiple similar vision endpoints on the same asset unless the user explicitly needs several distinct outputs.
- This provider exposes only the allowlisted stateless synchronous subset from the paired gateway manifest. Do not assume async jobs or stateful resource-management APIs are available unless the spec shows them explicitly.

Data.description: The returned data content. This data can be obtained only after the asynchronous task execution has succeeded, by invoking the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API and performing JSON deserialization on its Result field.

VideoUrl.description:
The URL address of the output video.  
> This URL is temporary and has a validity period of 30 minutes. It will expire and become inaccessible afterward. If you need to retain the file for a longer duration or permanently, access the URL and download the file within 30 minutes, then store it in your own OSS bucket or other storage space.
